Lean.PersistentHashMap.toList.code:
Lean.PersistentHashMap.toList.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} :
  {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → PersistentHashMap α β → List (α × β)
Lean.PersistentHashMap.toList.fullDefinition: def toList {_ : BEq α} {_ : Hashable α} (m : PersistentHashMap α β) : List (α × β) :=   m.foldl (init := []) fun ps k v => (k, v) :: ps
Lean.PersistentHashMap.toList.description: A function that converts a persistent hash map into a list of key-value pairs.

Lean.HashMap.toList.code: Lean.HashMap.toList.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → HashMap α β → List (α × β)
Lean.HashMap.toList.fullDefinition: def toList (m : HashMap α β) : List (α × β) :=   m.fold (init := []) fun r k v => (k, v)::r
Lean.HashMap.toList.description: A function that converts a hash map into a list of key-value pairs.

Lean.HashMap.code: Lean.HashMap.{u, v} (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [BEq α] [Hashable α] : Type (max 0 u v)
Lean.HashMap.fullDefinition: def HashMap (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [BEq α] [Hashable α] :=   { m : HashMapImp α β // m.WellFormed }
Lean.HashMap.description: A type representing a hash map that maps keys of one type to values of another type, under specific equality and hashing constraints for the keys.

Lean.HashMap.contains.code: Lean.HashMap.contains.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → HashMap α β → α → Bool
Lean.HashMap.contains.fullDefinition: @[inline] def contains (m : HashMap α β) (a : α) : Bool :=   match m with   | ⟨ m, _ ⟩ => m.contains a
Lean.HashMap.contains.description: A function that checks whether a specific key exists in a hash map.

Lean.HashMap.insert.code:
Lean.HashMap.insert.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} :
  {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → HashMap α β → α → β → HashMap α β
Lean.HashMap.insert.fullDefinition: def insert (m : HashMap α β) (a : α) (b : β) : HashMap α β :=   match m with   | ⟨ m, hw ⟩ =>     match h:m.insert a b with     | (m', _) => ⟨ m', by have aux := WellFormed.insertWff m a b hw; rw [h] at aux; assumption ⟩
Lean.HashMap.insert.description: A function that adds a key-value pair to a hash map, producing a new hash map.

Lean.HashMap.find!.code:
Lean.HashMap.find!.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} :
  {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → [inst : Inhabited β] → HashMap α β → α → β
Lean.HashMap.find!.fullDefinition: @[inline] def find! [Inhabited β] (m : HashMap α β) (a : α) : β :=   match m.find? a with   | some b => b   | none   => panic! "key is not in the map"
Lean.HashMap.find!.description: A function that retrieves the value associated with a specific key in a hash map, assuming the key exists.

Lean.HashMap.find?.code: Lean.HashMap.find?.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → HashMap α β → α → Option β
Lean.HashMap.find?.fullDefinition: @[inline] def find? (m : HashMap α β) (a : α) : Option β :=   match m with   | ⟨ m, _ ⟩ => m.find? a
Lean.HashMap.find?.description: A function that attempts to retrieve the value associated with a specific key in a hash map, returning an option type to indicate existence.

Lean.Name.updatePrefix.fullDefinition: def updatePrefix : Name → Name → Name   | anonymous, _    => anonymous   | str _ s,   newP => Name.mkStr newP s   | num _ s,   newP => Name.mkNum newP s
Lean.Name.updatePrefix.description: A function that updates the prefix of a given name.

Lean.Name.isInternalDetail.comment:
Returns true if this a part of name that is internal or dynamically
generated so that it may easily be changed.

Generally, user code should not explicitly use internal names.
Lean.Name.isInternalDetail.fullDefinition: def isInternalDetail : Name → Bool   | .str p s     =>     s.startsWith "_"       || matchPrefix s "eq_"       || matchPrefix s "match_"       || matchPrefix s "proof_"       || p.isInternalOrNum   | .num _ _     => true   | p            => p.isInternalOrNum where   /-- Check that a string begins with the given prefix, and then is only digit characters. -/   matchPrefix (s : String) (pre : String) :=     s.startsWith pre && (s |>.drop pre.length |>.all Char.isDigit)
Lean.Name.isInternalDetail.description: A function that checks if a given name is an internal or dynamically generated component.

Lean.SMap.contains.code: Lean.SMap.contains.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [BEq α] [Hashable α] : SMap α β → α → Bool
Lean.SMap.contains.fullDefinition: @[specialize] def contains : SMap α β → α → Bool   | ⟨true, m₁, _⟩, k   => m₁.contains k   | ⟨false, m₁, m₂⟩, k => m₁.contains k || m₂.contains k
Lean.SMap.contains.description: A function that checks whether a specific key exists in a structured map.

Lean.AssocList.find?.code: Lean.AssocList.find?.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [BEq α] (a : α) : AssocList α β → Option β
Lean.AssocList.find?.fullDefinition: def find? [BEq α] (a : α) : AssocList α β → Option β   | nil         => none   | cons k v es => match k == a with     | true  => some v     | false => find? a es
Lean.AssocList.find?.description: A function that retrieves an associated value from a list based on a given key, returning an option type to indicate the presence or absence of the value.

Lean.AssocList.cons.code: Lean.AssocList.cons.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (key : α) (value : β) (tail : AssocList α β) : AssocList α β
Lean.AssocList.cons.description: A construction that creates a new associated list entry by pairing a given key with a value and linking it to an existing list.

Lean.AssocList.nil.code: Lean.AssocList.nil.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : AssocList α β
Lean.AssocList.nil.description: An expression that represents an empty associated list, indicating the absence of any key-value pairs.

Lean.HashSet.code: Lean.HashSet.{u} (α : Type u) [BEq α] [Hashable α] : Type u
Lean.HashSet.fullDefinition: def HashSet (α : Type u) [BEq α] [Hashable α] :=   { m : HashSetImp α // m.WellFormed }
Lean.HashSet.description: A construction that defines a hash set, which is a collection of unique elements based on their hashed values.

Lean.HashSet.insert.code: Lean.HashSet.insert.{u} {α : Type u} : {x : BEq α} → {x_1 : Hashable α} → HashSet α → α → HashSet α
Lean.HashSet.insert.fullDefinition: @[inline] def insert (m : HashSet α) (a : α) : HashSet α :=   match m with   | ⟨ m, hw ⟩ => ⟨ m.insert a, WellFormed.insertWff m a hw ⟩
Lean.HashSet.insert.description: A function that inserts an element into a hash set, potentially increasing the collection while maintaining its uniqueness based on hashed values.

Lean.LOption.some.code: Lean.LOption.some.{u} {α : Type u} : α → Lean.LOption α
Lean.LOption.some.description: A construction that creates a non-empty optional value from a given element of a specified type.
